reason: I bill by the hour, so sorting receipts is time I get paid for, and if the bot misreads a handwritten nota I still have to check every row because my name is on the books. Maybe I would try the free 40 documents on one client, but I would not pay yet.
objection: If recognition is wrong, I am responsible for the books, so I end up checking everything anyway and saving nothing. And 5 groups per account is not enough when I have a chat with each client.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run a full month on one of my real clients with almost no corrections, plus enough groups to cover all my clients so I can take on more of them.
